items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Well at that time we used to rehearsal up and down Ramport Street... You remember the time Lewis came down here to play that peanut vendor? Yeah. Well that's the time I was playing with them then.

ctx.x: Before the Depression, the time you were with Kid Renee or after that?

No, that was after Depression. Let's see this. There it was around about... See Depression in 29. Must have been around about... 20... 37... 38... Something around about that. Yeah. Or it might have been before that, you see. Yeah, a little bit. Long before that. But I'm just giving a rough guess at it, you know. Yeah. About around about that time, you see. Well at that time we used to rehearsal up and down Ramport Street. See, sometimes they rehearsaled in the back of one ballroom. And then next time they…
Was that when Lewis was at the suburban gardens?
